text: Artificial intelligence is becoming a common part of many workplaces. One of its main benefits is automation, which takes over repetitive tasks like sorting emails, entering data, or checking inventory. This frees up time for employees to focus on more creative or complex work. Additionally, AI-powered productivity tools can schedule meetings, summarize documents, and even help with writing. However, the human-AI collaboration is not about replacing people. Instead, it works best when humans guide the technology, making final decisions and handling customer emotions. While some jobs are changing, they rarely disappear completely. Workers may need to learn new skills to work alongside AI, but this shift often leads to more interesting and less boring roles.
